{{Quote|One of the stranger tales of the Rebellion has to do with an encounter on Krant. Princess Leia traveled there to meet a Bothan spy when she was shot down by the Imperials.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''skirmished''' in the Krant system. It was one of the first events of the [[Krantian Civil War]].

==Prelude==
Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Krant]] became a major rendezvous point for [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Bothan spy [[Utric Sandov]] arranged a meeting with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] to discuss information that could be vital to the Rebel Alliance.

==The battle==
While Leia Organa was moving to Krant, her ship, the ''[[Cretacian]]'', came in contact with and fought [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. One of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] damaged the ''Cretacian'' and caused it to crash on the planet. Only Organa, the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and some [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] survived the crash.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I am Echuu Shen-Jon. I sensed a disturbance in the Force.''"<br />"''You're a Jedi Knight?''"<br />"''I have been in hiding since&hellip; the Jedi massacre&hellip;|Echuu Shen-Jon, meeting Leia Organa|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
On Krant, Leia Organa was ambushed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], but she was rescued by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Echuu Shen-Jon]]. She later met Utric Sandov, who revealed to her that the Empire had found the [[Vor'Na'Tu]].
